errors.evidence: The description only mentions star markers, but the data points from epoch 1 to 5 are marked with blue circles, and points from epoch 5 onwards are marked with blue stars.
The value 0.0002 is a Y-axis value (Learn Rate), not a value on the X-axis (Epoch). The phrasing is incorrect and misleading.

errors.text_span: 到达 x轴上的值为约0.0001
errors.evidence: The value 0.0001 is a Y-axis value (Learn Rate), but the description incorrectly states it is a value "on the x-axis". The x-axis represents Epoch.

errors.text_span: 在x轴上的值从1到10期间下降
errors.evidence: The description of the trend is incorrect. The learn rate (Y-value) increases sharply from Epoch 1 to 5, reaching its peak at Epoch 5, and then starts to decrease. It does not decrease over the entire period from 1 to 10.
The learn rate does not stabilize from epoch 10 to 30; it steadily decreases from a value of approximately 0.00095 to nearly 0.
